scope: Read-only official repository/paper feasibility review. No checkpoint bodies downloaded; no author code, training or accelerator execution.

training_evidence.discrepancy: CLI defaults differ from paper for learning rate and flow scale; exact released-checkpoint run config not provided.
training_evidence.splits: RLV/DID loaders require external train_list.txt/test_list.txt; none are in the pinned Git tree.
training_evidence.checkpoint_scope: Only BVI-RLV- and DID-labelled enhancement checkpoints. Exact training split/seed/config unverified; no SDSD-only checkpoint identified.

TempRetinex.target_optimization: predict.py/test.py set eval/no_grad; no target optimizer/backward. Recurrence and input-statistic brightness normalization are inference operations, not gradient adaptation.
TempRetinex.gt_boundary: test.py reports ordinary metrics and additionally GT histogram-matched metrics. is_hist_match=True by default. GT-matched outputs are inadmissible in prediction-only BVI comparisons; use original H3 output and common metric implementation.
portability: Prediction default weights/BVI-RLV.pt does not match published weights/BVI-RLV.pth.
Dataset loader resizes all images to1920x1080; a dedicated center16/crop256 adapter must bypass that resizing and reset recurrent state per clip.
Official weight load filters keys then merges initialized values; adapted evaluation must explicitly audit complete required model-key coverage.
No environment lock/requirements file or checkpoint provenance log in pinned tree.
Forward/backward reverse-inference protocol must be prespecified; current public predict/test are forward sequential and do not implement the paper's reverse pass.
TempRetinex.feasibility: Frozen inference on BVI is technically plausible with explicit adapter and CPU/NPU portability validation, but not yet executed. Released BVI weights cannot establish SDSD-source-only transfer. DID weights would be a separately labelled DID→BVI external-source reference, not SDSD-matched. Strict SDSD-only requires new source-only training with independently fixed config/split and no target tuning.

weights.kind: UniMatch optical flow only; not a full DWTA enhancement checkpoint

DWTA.full_enhancement_checkpoint: Not found in pinned tree, releases, or README links. README requires full trained checkpoint and explicitly distinguishes Stage-I-only initialization.

training.target_adaptation: Test.py is no_grad with recurrent state reset between videos; no target optimizer.

portability: CUDA mamba-ssm selective-scan dependency and custom deformable-convolution CUDA extension.
Official test only scores complete five-frame neighborhoods; matching all16 centerclip outputs requires declared boundary handling or additional context, not silent omission.
Config hard-codes DID train/test paths; no source SDSD released model identified.
DWTA.feasibility: Official implementation now available, but missing full enhancement checkpoint and CUDA-specific dependencies block a ready frozen NPU benchmark. No code/weights execution attempted.

VLLVE_plus_plus.status: No official VLLVE++ code/checkpoint confirmed in this targeted check; this is not proof none exists.
VLLVE_plus_plus.paper_release_statement: Code and trained models will be released upon publication.
VLLVE_plus_plus.author_link_found: Author publication page links IJCAI2025 LLVE_STCD, not a separately identified VLLVE++ release.
VLLVE_plus_plus.distinction: Already evaluated STCD/VLLVE predecessor must not be labelled VLLVE++.

novelty_boundary: Temporal conditioning, flow-guided recurrent pixel aggregation, correspondence refinement, and graph smoothing each have precedent. This review does not establish novelty or SOTA for observation-v2.
